text: In December 2015 Tech Mahindra and Mahindra & Mahindra agreed to purchase 76.06% of Pininfarina S.p.A.'s shares from the controlling shareholder Pincar.
short: Tech Mahindra and M&M bought 76.06% of Pininfarina in 2015.

source.name: The Times of India: Tech Mahindra and M&M shall purchase 76.06% of Pininfarina shares
source.quote: Tech Mahindra and M&M shall purchase 76.06% of Pininfarina shares from the current controlling shareholder Pincar at a price of Euro 1.1 per share.
